pages.name: Inference
pages.description: gRPC RED, batch queue, model revisions, device

rawConfiguration.text:
## Inference (`service.name = inference`, `${environment}`)
Python gRPC (`GRPC_PORT 50051`, Prometheus `:8333`). Knobs: `BATCH_SIZE`, `BATCH_TIMEOUT`, `BATCH_QUEUE_MAX_SIZE`, `MAX_INFLIGHT_DOC_CHUNKS`, `SPARK_MODEL_REVISION`, `FLARE_MODEL_REVISION`, `INFERENCE_PROVIDERS` (CUDA vs CPU). Cold start has 10m grace — warmup failures hide there.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `qps*60` WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS drops WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%queue%full%' OR message LIKE '%dropped%' OR message LIKE '%RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED%')
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND error = true FACET `rpc.grpc.status_code` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%DEADLINE_EXCEEDED%' OR message LIKE '%RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED%' OR message LIKE '%OOM%') TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT average(inference_batch_size) AS `batch size`, average(inference_queue_depth) AS `queue depth`, average(inference_inflight_chunks) AS inflight WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS rpm, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms`, percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET `model.revision`, `inference.provider` LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Device + host (GPU util, mem, CPU fallback)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(gpu_utilization) AS `gpu %`, average(gpu_memory_used_bytes / 1000000) AS `gpu MB`, average(system_cpu_percent) AS `cpu %` WHERE service.name IN ('inference', 'otel-collector') AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS `cpu fallback` WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND message LIKE '%CPUExecutionProvider%' OR message LIKE '%fallback%' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n FACET message WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%chunk%' OR message LIKE '%token%' OR message LIKE '%truncat%') LIMIT 20
FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample WHERE service.name = 'inference' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (level = 'error' OR severity = 'ERROR') FACET name LIMIT 20
